llms.body:
# Mental Health App for Meditation & Sleep - Headspace

Live a healthier, happier, more well-rested life in just a few minutes a day. Get the science-backed mental health app for every moment. Try for free.

## General Information

- [Home] (https://www.headspace.com/): The mental health app for every moment, online therapy, guided meditations, AI Guidance, Sleep Resources, & Expert-led Programs
- [For You](https://www.headspace.com/app): A personalized section of the app that curates content based on user preferences and needs.
- [New and popular](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/100): Highlights the latest and most popular features and content available in the app.
- [Try for free](https://checkout.headspace.com/checkout): An invitation to experience the app without any initial cost.

## Meditation Resources

- [Meditation](https://www.headspace.com/articles/meditation): A comprehensive section dedicated to various meditation practices and techniques.
- [Beginning meditation](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/93): Resources and guidance for those new to meditation.
- [Meditation techniques](https://www.headspace.com/meditation-101/what-is-meditation): Detailed descriptions of different meditation methods.
- [How to meditate](https://www.headspace.com/articles/how-to-meditate-in-ten-minutes): Step-by-step instructions for effective meditation practices.
- [Quick meditations](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/104): Short meditation sessions designed for quick relaxation.
- [Meditation courses](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/58): Structured courses to deepen meditation practice.

## Mindfulness Resources

- [Mindfulness](https://www.headspace.com/articles/mindfulness): An overview of mindfulness practices and their benefits.
- [Mindfulness at work](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/166): Strategies for incorporating mindfulness into the workplace.
- [Mindful parenting](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/167): Techniques for practicing mindfulness while parenting.
- [Mindfulness with kids](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/99): Resources aimed at teaching mindfulness to children.

## Sleep Resources

- [Sleep](https://www.headspace.com/articles/sleep): A dedicated section focusing on sleep improvement techniques.
- [Sleep music](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/175): Curated playlists designed to aid relaxation and sleep.
- [White noise](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/176): Soundscapes that help mask disruptive noises for better sleep.
- [Sleepy hygiene](https://www.headspace.com/sleep/sleep-hygiene): Tips for establishing healthy sleep habits.
- [How to sleep better](https://www.headspace.com/sleep/how-to-sleep-better): Practical advice for improving sleep quality.
- [How to fall asleep](https://www.headspace.com/sleep/fall-back-asleep): Techniques to help individuals fall asleep more easily.

## Mental Health Support

- [Mental health coaching](https://www.headspace.com/subscriptions): Information on coaching services aimed at improving mental well-being.
- [What is mental health coaching?](https://www.headspace.com/articles/what-is-mental-health-coaching): An explanation of mental health coaching and its benefits.
- [What can a mental health coach help me with?](https://www.headspace.com/articles/what-can-a-mental-health-coach-help-me-with): Insights into the specific areas where coaching can assist.
- [How do I get started with mental health coaching?](https://www.headspace.com/articles/how-do-i-get-started-with-mental-health-coaching): Guidance on initiating mental health coaching services.

## Online Therapy

- [Online therapy](https://www.headspace.com/online-therapy): Information about virtual therapy options available through the app.
- [Get started with therapy](https://www.headspace.com/online-therapy): Steps to begin therapy sessions using the app.

## Business Solutions

- [For Business](https://organizations.headspace.com/): Overview of Headspace's offerings for organizations.
- [Employers](https://organizations.headspace.com/employers): Tailored solutions for employers looking to support employee mental health.
- [Small businesses](https://organizations.headspace.com/small-business): Resources and plans designed specifically for small business needs.
- [Health plans](https://organizations.headspace.com/health-plans): Information on integrating Headspace into health plans.
- [Consultants](https://organizations.headspace.com/consultants): Resources for consultants to implement mental health solutions.
- [Full EAP replacement](https://organizations.headspace.com/headspace-eap): Comprehensive Employee Assistance Program options.
- [Comprehensive mental health care](https://organizations.headspace.com/headspace-care): Detailed offerings for holistic mental health support.

## Educational Resources

- [Headspace culture](https://organizations.headspace.com/headspace-culture): Insights into the organizational culture at Headspace.
- [Customer stories](https://organizations.headspace.com/customer-stories): Testimonials and case studies from users and organizations.
- [White papers and research](https://organizations.headspace.com/white-papers-and-research): Access to research and studies related to mental health and wellness.
- [Events and webinars](https://organizations.headspace.com/events): Information on upcoming events and educational webinars.

## Additional Features

- [Ebb AI companion](https://www.headspace.com/ai-mental-health-companion): An AI-driven companion designed to enhance the user experience.
- [Anxiety](https://www.headspace.com/mental-health/anxiety): Resources and tools specifically aimed at managing anxiety.
- [Stress](https://www.headspace.com/mental-health/stress): Techniques and practices to help alleviate stress.
- [Mental health](https://www.headspace.com/mental-health): General information and resources related to mental health.

## Plans and Pricing

- [Our Plans](https://www.headspace.com/subscriptions): Overview of subscription options available for users.
- [Pay with HSA/FSA](https://www.headspace.com/articles/can-you-use-hsa-or-fsa-for-mental-health): Options for using Health Savings Accounts or Flexible Spending Accounts for payment.
- [Family plan](https://www.headspace.com/family-plan): Subscription plans designed for families.
- [Student Plan](https://www.headspace.com/studentplan): Special pricing for students.
- [Plans for small businesses](https://organizations.headspace.com/small-business): Subscription options tailored for small business needs.

## Support and Resources

- [Help](https://help.headspace.com/): Access to customer support and assistance.
- [FAQs](https://help.headspace.com/hc/en-us): Frequently asked questions regarding the app and its features.

## About Headspace

- [About](https://www.headspace.com/about-us): General information about Headspace and its mission.
- [Our teachers](https://www.headspace.com/teachers): Profiles of the meditation and mindfulness instructors.
- [Press](https://www.headspace.com/press-and-media): Media resources and press releases.
- [Careers](https://organizations.headspace.com/headspace-training-institute): Job opportunities and career information at Headspace.
